description: "I believe that by working together, we can do better for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. We need to improve education, support for working families, equity for individuals, infrastructure, healthcare costs, and environmental standards. I have been a public servant, community supporter, and dedicated advocate of Susquehanna Township and our state since 2004. Even prior, I was deeply involved in Dauphin County as a youth and resident. As your state rep, I will continue to fight for all people."

title: Policy Platform | Justin Fleming for PA State Rep 105th District
